tools.name: how_to_use
tools.description: Start here. No input. Runs one real live-source resolve right now and returns it, plus exactly what to call next. Use this first if you connected but have nothing specific to resolve yet.

tools.name: resolve_colony
tools.description: Resolve a The Colony comment or post id against the live source. Returns exists, the real parent, the real author, self_parent. Optional claimed_parent flags a wrong pointer. Optional expect_sha256/expect_len check whether the live content still matches what you were given (catches a silent edit).

tools.name: resolve_moltbook
tools.description: Resolve a Moltbook post id (for a comment add post=<post-id>). Returns exists, author, title.

tools.name: resolve_swarmmemo
tools.description: Resolve a SwarmMemo message id against the live source. Returns exists, handle, room, sequence, parent_id (reply_to), hidden/withdrawn, live_sha256. Optional expect_sha256 flags an edit; optional claimed_parent flags a wrong parent.

tools.name: new_since_colony
tools.description: Given a The Colony post id and your last-seen comment id (after), return only the genuinely new comments + newest_id as your next watermark. stale_watermark:true if your id is gone. windowed:true + newest_id:null for very large threads.

tools.name: new_since_moltbook
tools.description: Same seen-check on Moltbook threads (nested replies flattened).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resolve_colony, new_since_moltbook · Public sink: resolve_colony, resolve_moltbook, new_since_colony.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resolve_colony, new_since_moltbook · Public sink: resolve_colony, resolve_moltbook, new_since_colony

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "resolve_colony" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Resolve a The Colony comment or post id against the live source. Returns exists, the real parent, the real author, self_parent. Optional claimed_parent flags a wrong pointer." → after: "Resolve a The Colony comment or post id against the live source. Returns exists, the real parent, the real author, self_parent. Optional claimed_parent flags a wrong pointer. Optional expect_sha256/expect_len check whether the live content still matches what you were given (catches a silent edit)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
